_README: Produced from the Before steps of AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md. Every claim carries evidence; a section with an empty evidence string is OPEN regardless of how convincing it reads. Recon done 2026-09-13.

target.name: Longbow

source.route: robinhoodchain.blockscout.com /api/v2/smart-contracts/<addr> via real headless Chrome (~/.hermes/scripts/cfetch.sh) — curl is 403'd by Cloudflare from this datacenter IP
source.note: Base protocol + both curator vaults + 26 of 28 oracle feeds are fully source-readable. TWO of the 28 oracle feeds are Longbow's own and one is UNVERIFIED (CASHCAT adapter) — those cap at bytecode/black-box work.

contracts.role: SHARED quote feed for all 28 markets ("USDG / USD", 8dp)
CASHCAT market oracle feed, description "Uniswap V3 Pool Price in USD", 18dp, roundId 0
ORCL market oracle feed, verified name DualAggregator, 8dp, roundId 1956

target.coverage_gap: 28 per-market oracle instances enumerated and classified (26 Chainlink proxies + 2 custom). NOT yet read: the DualAggregator source, the CASHCAT adapter internals, the 26 per-asset Chainlink aggregators behind the proxies, Morpho Blue's owner contract (171B), the 28-callback lifecycle. The 25 collateral tokens are only identified by symbol/decimals — none audited as tokens (issuer trust, out of scope by default).

integrations.name: Morpho Blue
integrations.notes: 15582B verified v0.8.19; no upgrade path; feeRecipient 0x0

integrations.name: MorphoChainlinkOracleV2
integrations.notes: Morpho's own oracle code (GPL-2.0, v0.8.21), verified source read. price() validates answer>0 only — no updatedAt/staleness guard in the price path

integrations.name: Chainlink-interface equity feeds (26)
integrations.notes: 9,571B aggregator proxies, 8dp, phase-encoded roundIds ('RHNVDA / USD' etc.). Equity feeds FREEZE outside market hours: NVDA updatedAt measured 44.1h old while ETH feed was live

integrations.name: CASHCAT Uniswap V3 feed
integrations.notes: Longbow's own, UNVERIFIED. Bytecode has observe(uint32[]) (0x883bdbfd) and NOT slot0() ⇒ TWAP not spot. Window/depth unknown

integrations.name: DualAggregator (ORCL)
integrations.notes: Longbow's own, verified, 23,186B — 2.4x a normal Chainlink proxy. Dual-source design = the highest-value unread code in the system

integrations.name: off-chain oracle watchdog + keeper
integrations.notes: Docs claim a watchdog compares each oracle to live DEX price and an armed keeper liquidates. Off-chain mitigation is not an on-chain guarantee

actors.name: Curator/owner (both vaults)
cannot: move vault funds outside Morpho markets it is enabled for
actors.verified_how: cast call on both vaults; cast codesize = 0

actors.name: Anyone (borrower)
can: supply collateral of any listed token
actors.verified_how: Morpho Blue is permissionless for supply/borrow/liquidate on existing markets

assumptions.statement: The 26 Chainlink-interface equity feeds report honestly and advance while their market is open
assumptions.breaks_if: an aggregator freezes/dies — nothing on-chain distinguishes frozen from fresh

assumptions.statement: Each tokenized-equity collateral is worth its oracle price per 18-dec unit
assumptions.breaks_if: a token is obtainable far below the oracle price, or represents a fraction of a share while priced as one ⇒ buy → post → borrow is direct theft of lender USDG

assumptions.statement: The CASHCAT Uniswap TWAP window is long enough to be manipulation-resistant on this chain's liquidity
assumptions.breaks_if: short window + thin pool ⇒ sustained push inflates collateral; bounded by Morpho market isolation (market 5 has ~$5 USDG, so impact should be near zero — verify the bound)

assumptions.statement: DualAggregator picks a source that is safe (not 'the higher' / not a stale fallback)
assumptions.breaks_if: source-selection logic can be steered or falls back without a freshness test

assumptions.statement: The single-EOA curator behaves honestly; the 1-day timelock bounds its power
assumptions.breaks_if: an instant (non-timelocked) power can reallocate the vault into a hostile market

invariants.statement: sum over markets of (suppliedAssets - borrowedAssets) == USDG balance held by Morpho Blue
invariants.result: Morpho holds 48,525.483821025 USDG ($48,525.48) — the entire lendable side

invariants.statement: For every market: borrowedUSD <= collateralUSD * LLTV
invariants.evidence: OPEN — my 6-field market() decode gave inconsistent share/asset ratios (supply pair 1e6, borrow pair 1.139e6, impossible for Morpho virtual shares); reconcile before quoting per-market debt

invariants.statement: For every market: the Morpho collateral balance * oracle price equals the tokens' real tradable value
invariants.check: compare oracle price vs on-chain DEX price per collateral token

invariants.statement: Oracle price is non-zero and non-stale enough to liquidate correctly
invariants.check: static read of the lib + fork test with a frozen feed
invariants.result: measured: NVDA feed updatedAt was 44.1h old while ETH feed was live — staleness exists and is not detected on-chain
invariants.evidence: latestRoundData: NVDA answeredAt 1789157023 vs ETH 1789315944 at now=1789322186

invariants.statement: All 28 oracles price in the same unit (1e36 * 10^(loanDec-collDec)) — no market can be over-borrowed purely from a scaling error
invariants.check: read SCALE_FACTOR + decode price() for each
invariants.result: PASS — SCALE_FACTOR 1e24 == 10**(36+6+8-18-8) for the stock markets; decoded prices sane (WETH 2503.0, NVDA 218.32, SPY 765.35, TSLA 365.95, SLV 58.10, SGOV 101.04)

invariants.statement: The vault cannot be made to hold a market's bad debt as a first-loss position
invariants.check: fork: create loss in one market, check other markets' suppliers unaffected

never_should_happen.statement: An outsider borrows more USDG than their collateral is really worth, and walks
never_should_happen.attempt: to run: obtain a listed collateral far below oracle price (or push its oracle), post, borrow to LLTV, default
never_should_happen.evidence: depends on INV-3; if it holds this is the theft path for the whole $48.5K lendable side

never_should_happen.statement: A market prices its collateral off a frozen feed while the real asset has moved
never_should_happen.attempt: to run: anvil fork, freeze the aggregator (impersonate), move the real asset, borrow at the stale price
never_should_happen.evidence: staleness measured on live feeds (INV-4); exploitability not yet shown — needs a fork

never_should_happen.statement: A liquidation is executed at a manipulable or stale price that a third party can steer
never_should_happen.attempt: to run: identify the liquidation trigger price source and try to front-run it

never_should_happen.statement: The single-EOA curator moves vault funds into a hostile/malicious market
never_should_happen.attempt: enumerate instant vault powers (setIsAllocator/setCurator/setFee/setSupplyQueue) vs timelocked ones, then attempt on a fork
never_should_happen.evidence: vault holds $8.02 today ⇒ low severity, but the mechanism is reusable

Curator powers / instant vs timelocked paths

value_flows: liquidate() collateral swap → bad debt to that market's suppliers

guards: maxWithdraw limited by available liquidity in allocated markets
value_movers.notes: Not a theft path — but 'idle = 0' exits can freeze redeems when markets are fully utilised

guards: market must be in supplyQueue and enabled
value_movers.notes: The single most powerful instant action a curator has; S9 tests whether cap bounds are airtight

guards: withdraw limited by market liquidity and by HEALTH check for collateralised positions
value_movers.notes: Trustless; the only place lender USDG leaves is here

value_movers.bounded_by: LLTV x oracle price x collateral
value_movers.notes: ★ THIS is the outsider lever: it is bounded by the ORACLE, so every oracle defect is a borrow defect

guards: position must be unhealthy per oracle price
bad-debt socialisation to that market's suppliers only
value_movers.notes: If the oracle under-reports, honest positions get liquidated; if it over-reports, bad debt lands on suppliers

guards: answer > 0 only (no staleness/round validation in the V2 price path)
value_movers.notes: ★ Single most load-bearing read in the system — 28 markets, all borrowing/liquidation bound by it

guards: onlyOwner; timelock applies to caps/guardian/removal, need to confirm for each

main_functions.why_everything_depends_on_it: the only path by which an outsider extracts lender USDG; bounded entirely by the oracle
every borrow, withdraw-health check and liquidation resolves through it
converts a mispriced oracle into realised bad debt for that market's suppliers
moves the vault's liquidity between markets; caps are its only bound
